 -3-  NC: 2024:KHC:20094  CRL.P No. 4608 of 2024  ORDER Learned counsel for the petitioners seeks leave of this Court to withdraw the petition, as bail is already granted to the petitioners by the learned Sessions Judge.
Hence, he prays to dismiss the petition as having become infructuous.
He has filed a memo to that effect.

2. The submission is accepted and the memo is placed on record.
3. In view of the above, the petition is dismissed as having become infructuous.
